title.rendered: Labour Colony in Ghaziabad — Prefab Worker Housing

content.rendered:
Construction across Ghaziabad — from residential townships in Indirapuram and Vaishali to infrastructure work along Raj Nagar Extension and NH-9 — needs organised on-site worker housing that meets welfare norms without slowing the build. A prefabricated labour colony in Ghaziabad lets you set up compliant worker accommodation quickly, then expand, relocate, or remove it as the project moves. SAMAN Portable manufactures labour colonies, worker camps, and labour accommodation as a direct manufacturer, and serves all Ghaziabad construction sites from our Jalpura, Greater Noida 201308 factory — the same NCR industrial belt, so dispatch and installation stay local.

SAMAN manufactures and dispatches labour colony units directly from our Greater Noida facility (Jalpura, PIN 201308) — factory-to-site delivery across Delhi NCR without middlemen. For phased or fast-track workforces, our prefab labour camp blocks scale unit by unit.

Serving India since 2009, incorporated as SAMAN POS India Private Limited in 2019, we build worker housing on an IS 2062 mild-steel frame with insulated PUF panels, sized for the labour strength your Ghaziabad site actually needs.

Why Organised Worker Housing Matters on Ghaziabad Sites

As residential towers and commercial projects rise across Indirapuram, Vaishali, and Raj Nagar Extension, contractors need structured worker accommodation that keeps the workforce on site and the project compliant. Prefabricated labour colonies are the quickest route to that, because the units arrive factory-built and are assembled on location.

Urban Growth Driving Demand

The spread of residential townships in Indirapuram and commercial developments along NH-9 keeps construction activity high. That activity needs a stable workforce housed close to the work, which supports project continuity and labour-welfare compliance.

Regulatory Compliance Requirements

The Uttar Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Act expects suitable accommodation for on-site workers. A prefabricated labour colony offers a fast path to that while keeping sanitation, ventilation, and fire-safety standards in place. Typical requirements include:

  • Mandatory sanitation facilities
  • Minimum space per worker
  • Fire-safety provisions
  • Proper ventilation
  • Stable, certified structure

    • SAMAN Portable's Labour Camp Solutions in Ghaziabad

    Ready-to-Assemble Modules

    Our prefabricated labour colonies arrive as factory-built modules and are assembled on site, with electrical and plumbing points fitted for quick commissioning. You can review the full portable labour hutments for the standard build.

    Hygienic Living Standards

    Each labour colony uses washable PUF panel interiors, proper ventilation, and dedicated sanitation blocks — a cleaner environment that helps reduce illness-related absenteeism on long projects.

    Scalable Configurations

    Start with basic accommodation and add modules as your project grows. The modular design lets you extend the colony without disturbing existing units or worker routines.

    Need Worker Housing in Ghaziabad?

    Tell us your labour strength and site location, and our team will plan a labour colony layout and quote.

    Call +91 88616 22859 Send Enquiry

    Served Direct From Our Greater Noida Factory

    SAMAN Portable supplies Ghaziabad as a direct manufacturer, not a reseller. Worker housing for Ghaziabad sites is built and dispatched from our Jalpura, Greater Noida 201308 factory, which sits in the same NCR industrial belt as Ghaziabad — so transport is short and our installation crew reaches Indirapuram, Vaishali, Raj Nagar Extension, and other Ghaziabad zones without long-distance handling. Buying factory-direct means you deal with the people who fabricate the units, which keeps specification, pricing, and after-sales support clear. As a company we have completed 500+ projects across India, and our build standards stay the same for every labour colony we dispatch.

    Planning a Site in Vaishali or Indirapuram?

    Get a site-specific labour colony layout and quote from the factory that builds it.

    Call +91 88616 22859 Send Enquiry

    Design Built for Urban Construction Constraints

    Space-Optimised Layouts

    Urban sites in Ghaziabad often have tight space. Our labour colonies are planned to fit:

  • Safety walkways between units
  • Vertical G+1 configurations to add capacity on a small footprint
  • Integrated sanitation blocks to save space
  • Modular kitchen with fire-safety provisions
  • Clear entry/exit points for worker flow

    • Weather-Resistant Construction

    Ghaziabad's hot summers and monsoon rains need a sturdy build:

  • Two-way sloped roofing for monsoon drainage
  • PUF-insulated walls for temperature control
  • Raised foundations to resist water ingress
  • Weather-resistant exterior finishes
  • IS 2062 MS-frame structure for strength

    • Room Layouts With Sanitary Units and Common Areas

    Multi-room labour colony layout with integrated sanitation facilities

    Sleeping Quarters

  • Worker rooms sized to your labour strength
  • Double-decker steel bunk beds
  • Individual storage lockers
  • Cross-ventilation windows
  • Energy-efficient LED lighting

    • Sanitation Blocks

  • Toilet and bathing blocks sized to worker count
  • Separate shower facilities
  • Bio-digester options for remote sites
  • Easy-clean surfaces for hygiene
  • Water-saving fixtures

    • Common Areas

  • Covered dining space
  • Modular kitchen facility
  • Recreation zone options
  • First-aid station
  • Supervisor office module
    • Configuration Use Footprint Best For
    Single-level multi-room Standard worker camp Larger ground area Open Indirapuram residential sites
    G+1 multi-room Same capacity, half the ground area Compact Space-constrained Vaishali sites
    Extended multi-block Large workforce, phased Expandable Raj Nagar Extension townships

    SAMAN labour colony configurations are built to support compliance with the Uttar Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Act standards for worker accommodation. Capacity, room count, and sanitation ratios are planned around your actual site requirement.

    RCC Foundation, IS 2062 MS Frame, and PUF Panels

    Materials That Last on a Construction Site

    Every SAMAN labour colony uses industrial-grade materials chosen to balance durability with cost:

  • 50–60mm PUF insulated wall panels with PPGI sheet on both sides
  • IS 2062 mild-steel (MS) structural frame with anti-corrosion coating
  • RCC foundation plinths with moisture barrier
  • Insulated, sloped roof panels for drainage
  • Aluminium anodized sliding windows for ventilation

    • Built to Stay Stable and Safe

    The engineering is designed to hold up across seasons and re-use:

  • IS 2062 MS frame for structural strength
  • Fire-retardant panel materials
  • Termite- and pest-resistant build
  • PUF insulation for indoor temperature control
  • Low maintenance, designed for relocation

    • Practical limits to plan for: the colony needs a reasonably level foundation, it is intended as site/temporary worker housing rather than permanent residential, and any heavy customisation can affect the build timeline.

    Component Material Thickness Advantage
    Wall Panels PUF with PPGI sheets 50–60mm Thermal insulation, lightweight
    Roof Panels PUF with PPGI sheets 30–40mm Water-resistant, insulated
    Structure IS 2062 mild steel (MS) 2–3mm High strength, anti-corrosion coated
    Doors Insulated steel 40mm Security, weather-sealing
    Windows Aluminium anodized 1.2mm Sliding function, low maintenance

    Backed by our standard cover: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. SAMAN POS India Private Limited is ISO 9001:2015 certified, and returns are accepted within 7 days of delivery or installation.

    From Factory to Ghaziabad Site — The Install Process

    How a SAMAN labour colony moves from our Greater Noida factory to your site

  • Site preparation and foundation — our team assesses the site, marks the layout, and prepares the foundation plinths to the approved design.
  • Structure assembly — the IS 2062 MS frame is erected and the main structural components are secured in place.
  • Panel installation — wall and roof PUF panels are fitted, forming an insulated, weather-protected envelope.
  • Interior fit-out — electrical, plumbing, beds, lockers, and sanitation fixtures are installed.
  • Quality check and handover — final inspection, system testing, and handover with documentation.

    • Need Worker Housing on a Tight Schedule?

    Share your timeline and site details and we will plan dispatch and installation from our Greater Noida factory.

    Call +91 88616 22859 Send Enquiry

    Get a Labour Colony Quote for Your Ghaziabad Site

    Why Choose SAMAN Portable?

  • Direct manufacturer — serving India since 2009, incorporated 2019
  • NCR worker housing dispatched from our Jalpura, Greater Noida 201308 factory
  • IS 2062 MS frame with insulated PUF panels
  • ISO 9001:2015 certified; 500+ projects completed across India
  • 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life
  • Built to support compliance with local labour-welfare regulations

    • You can also explore SAMAN's labour colony range to see standard build options before you enquire.

    Call +91 88616 22859






    Ready to House Your Workforce in Ghaziabad?

    Deploying a site in Raj Nagar Extension, Indirapuram, or Vaishali? Get a labour colony plan and quote from SAMAN Portable.

    Call +91 88616 22859 Send Enquiry

    FAQs: Labour Colony in Ghaziabad


    How long does it take to install a labour colony in Ghaziabad?

    Timelines depend on the number of units, capacity, and any customisation. Because the modules are factory-built at our Greater Noida unit and only assembled on site, installation is much faster than conventional construction. Share your site details and required worker strength and we will confirm a delivery and installation schedule for your project.


    What does a labour colony in Ghaziabad cost?

    Pricing is quote-based, because it depends on capacity, room count, sanitation blocks, G+1 vs single-level, and finishing. We do not publish a fixed price for worker housing. Send your worker capacity and site location and we will prepare a clear, itemised quote on request.


    Do your labour colonies meet regulatory requirements?

    Our labour colonies are built to support compliance with the Uttar Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Act standards for worker accommodation, including sanitation, ventilation, and fire-safety provisions. We help you plan room and sanitation ratios around your actual worker count.


    Can the colony be relocated after the project ends?

    Yes. The modular, bolted MS-frame design allows the units to be dismantled and reinstalled at a new site. We can quote dismantling and reinstallation so the colony moves with your next project.


    Where is the labour colony built and dispatched from?

    Worker housing for Ghaziabad is manufactured and dispatched from our Jalpura, Greater Noida 201308 factory, in the same NCR industrial belt. This keeps transport and installation local across Indirapuram, Vaishali, Raj Nagar Extension, and other Ghaziabad zones.


    What warranty comes with a SAMAN labour colony?

    Every labour colony is covered by 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing, with a 20–25 years engineered service life. SAMAN POS India Private Limited is ISO 9001:2015 certified, and returns are accepted within 7 days of delivery or installation.

    Certifications and Manufacturer Credentials

    SAMAN POS India Private Limited (POS = Portable Office Solutions) has manufactured steel labour colony units since 2009 (incorporated 2019), with 500+ projects across India from our plants at Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099 and Greater Noida (Vill Jalpura, Tehsil Dadri, Greater Noida, Gautambudha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh 201308). Certifications and registrations: ISO 9001:2015 (Cert No. E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (Cert No. E20250218646), ISO 45001:2018 (Cert No. E20250218647), NSIC enlisted (Ref. NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207), DPIIT-recognised startup (Ref. DIPP56005), Udyam registered (UDYAM-KR-03-0172770), GST 29ABBCS7101B1ZR (Bangalore) and 09ABBCS7101B1ZT (Noida). IS 2062 MS frame with insulated PUF panels. See our portable labour hutments or the full labour colony range.
